Based on the retrieved knowledge, here is a summary of your resume [Source 1]: You are a B.Tech CSE student with strong foundations in Data Structures, Algorithms, and Object-Oriented Programming, experienced in building scalable full-stack applications and backend systems. You are passionate about solving real-world problems using technology and interested in applying software engineering in financial services and large-scale systems.

Your work experience [Source 2] includes a Summer Research Intern position at SRM University-AP, where you built an end-to-end ML system using Gradient Boosting to predict credit scores, and a Core Team Member position at Google Developer Groups (GDG), where you tracked registration data and increased participant engagement.

You have proficiency in various programming languages [Source 3], including Python, JavaScript, C, C++, and Java, as well as experience with web technologies, backend and APIs, databases, machine learning, and data science.

Additionally, you have obtained several certifications [Source 4], including Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2025 Certified Data Science Professional, Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 17 Developer, and MongoDB Certified Associate Developer (Node.js).

Note that [Source 5] appears to be a medical report and is not relevant to your resume summary.
Tell me more about my projects

Based on the retrieved knowledge [Source 2], you have worked on several projects, including:

1. Crop Disease Classification: You built a production-ready CNN (MobileNetV2) that achieved 96.5% accuracy across 38 disease classes. You also deployed a Flask API with a 1.2-second inference time, which was tested on 500+ sample images by users. This project reduced diagnosis time from 2-3 days to under 2 seconds.

2. AI-Based Peer Behavior Similarity Detector: You built an AI-powered anomaly detection system that analyzed 8,000+ user records with 92% precision. You designed a composite scoring system with 6 similarity metrics, which improved the detection rate by 18%. You also created an interactive Streamlit dashboard used by 15+ peers, reducing analysis time from 2 hours to 10 minutes.

3. Collaborative Class – Academic Collaboration Platform: You built a full-stack role-based platform (React.js + Node.js + MongoDB) that supported 200+ active users. You developed real-time notifications using Socket.IO and analytics dashboards that tracked 10+ metrics. This project reduced assignment monitoring time by 50% through automated workflows.

These projects demonstrate your experience in building scalable full-stack applications, working with machine learning and data science, and developing backend systems. They also highlight your ability to solve real-world problems using technology and your interest in applying software engineering in various domains.
